_notes.reviewer.model: Prefer a capable model from a different family than the working agent; fallback is used on auth/availability errors. null = the chat model; /ledger model sets this key.
_notes.turnModel: Set to a cheap model id to enable the optional per-turn LLM ledger check (prompts/LEDGER_TURN.md). null = code-only monitor.
_notes.routing.autoSteer: Deterministic findings only. Reviewer flags never auto-steer; use /flag <id> send.
_notes.reviewer.triggers.onBreakpoint: Fires when the ledger's Next item changes or a Checks item resolves.
_notes.compaction.annotateSummaries: After each compaction, the reviewer model checks the summary against MEMENTO.md and MODEL_SPEC.md and adds a separate note listing stale statements. The summary itself is never changed.
_notes.autoEnable: Switch the ledger on at session start when files.ledger exists. /ledger on|off overrides this for the session.
